content.text: Digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-how-one-3|creators]] in regions like Nigeria and Ghana often face abrupt bans from platforms like Stripe and PayPal, leaving them stranded without a viable solution. These platforms operate in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, making them inaccessible to many. The looming threat of account suspensions, where PayPal can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, highlights an urgent need for alternatives. Sovereign commerce infrastructure emerges as the solution, offering a permanent, reliable foundation for digital creators to operate without the risk of sudden account bans or fund holds.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

Stripe and PayPal provide standardized payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-2|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-7|Solutions When]] that facilitate transactions for digital creators. However, they inherently lock users into their ecosystems, with substantial fees and stringent compliance checks. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, exemplified by solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, offers complete ownership and control of digital businesses. This includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and no reliance on third-party platforms. Creators utilizing sovereign stacks can operate independently and sustainably, without the fear of losing access to their accounts or funds.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often restrict services based on geographical location, which leaves creators in many countries without options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be universally applicable, enabling creators from any region to set up their online stores. COREMERCH’s solutions are built to circumvent these geographical limitations, allowing creators from Nigeria, Ghana, and similar markets to operate freely. By leveraging blockchain technology and decentralized payment options like NOWPayments, creators can bypass the traditional barriers imposed by conventional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed and fees, traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe often impose delays and high transaction costs. For instance, PayPal may hold funds for an extended period after a sale, creating cash flow issues for creators. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions ensure instant crypto payment verification with minimal fees—typically around 0.5%—and no KYC requirements, allowing creators to receive payments immediately. This direct access to funds is a game-changer, empowering creators to reinvest in their businesses without unnecessary delays.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you true ownership of your digital products.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The difference in ownership and delivery is stark between traditional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure. With Stripe or PayPal, creators are often subjected to platform rules, with limited control over their data and customer relationships. Conversely, platforms like COREMERCH guarantee full data ownership and autonomy over sales processes. The Edge Commerce Stack, for example, automates order processing and delivery through tools like Supabase and Cloudflare Workers, ensuring that creators can focus on their craft while maintaining complete control over their business operations.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and circumstances. If you're based in a restricted country and seeking immediate solutions, adopting sovereign commerce infrastructure is paramount. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a robust choice, quickly deployable within 48 hours, and configured for optimal performance. For creators already facing the risks of account restrictions, this infrastructure not only provides a safety net but also positions them for future growth without the threat of arbitrary bans or fund holds.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
No more account bans or fund holds — operate freely with your own store.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
